metadata.paper: Fuzzy-Gated Verification of LLM Agents for Industrial Fault Diagnosis: An Evolutionary-Optimized Closed-Loop Framework
metadata.campaign: R1 remeasure campaign v3 (chat-template + parser fixes), completed 2026-07-23
metadata.note: Mirror of every number reported in the paper. Every value traces to a results/*.json artifact named in the per-section provenance field. Aggregation for main_paired_comparison: per-split decode-seed means, then mean/std over the 10 bootstrap splits (matches paper Table tab:main).

datasets.care: CARE Wind SCADA (267,569 windows, 2 classes, 52 tags, dataset-level split)

main_paired_comparison.provenance: results/statistical_protocol.json raw_metrics (10 splits x 3 decode seeds, 160 episodes/split)

paired_significance.provenance: results/statistical_protocol.json comparisons (Wilcoxon signed-rank N=10, Holm over 15 comparisons, bootstrap CIs)

verification_baselines.provenance: results/verification_baselines.json datasets.*.summary (3 decode seeds; calibration on validation only, coverage-matched)

moo_comparison.provenance: results/moo_comparison.json (10 paired runs, 5050 evals/run, reference front = union)

non_ruspini_robustness.provenance: results/non_ruspini_robustness.json (simultaneous +-0.05/+-0.10 shifts of six breakpoints, 3 seeds)

backbone_comparison.provenance: results/backbone_results.json (Mistral) + results/ablation_results.json full variant (Llama-3.1), both 3 decode seeds

classical_baselines.provenance: results/experiment_results.json (run_main.py main_classification output; v2 campaign artifact, LLM-independent stage, sentinel preserved by v3). Single deterministic run, seed 42, full held-out test splits (36001/883/34746). Scale verified: all 30 accuracy/top3 values invert to integer correct-counts at full-scale test denominators.

recent_sota_reproductions.provenance: results/recent_sota.json (v2 campaign artifact, LLM-generation-independent stage; sentinel preserved by v3 orchestrator). Repository-split reproductions, 3 seeds; no source-paper numbers.

protocols.reporting: repository-split reimplementations; no numbers copied from source papers

fdllm.protocol: 15 statistical features, rank-4 LoRA, lr=1e-4, bf16, 3 epochs

t2mfdf.protocol: time-series encoder + fault-description BERT-family embeddings + multimodal fusion

overall.note: Automated-judge agreement; not human inter-annotator agreement.

pq16.note: Automated-judge agreement; not human inter-annotator agreement.

cwru.note: Automated-judge agreement; not human inter-annotator agreement.

care.note: Automated-judge agreement; not human inter-annotator agreement.

judge_robustness.provenance: results/independent_judge.json audit_rows (3 decode seeds x 160 episodes per dataset, gate decisions and both judges' verdicts from the same run)
judge_robustness.definition: released-hallucination rate = fraction of all episodes in which a judge-flagged hypothesis is gated to proceed; Agent-noV proceeds on all episodes by construction

per_domain_recalibration.provenance: results/regression_crossdomain.json per_cycle, in_domain rows (baseline = global PQ-tuned operating point, updated = that domain's own MOPSO re-tuning on its validation split)
per_domain_recalibration.caveat: evaluated on each domain's regression suite, which oversamples escalated and disagreement episodes; absolute rates are not comparable to tab:main, the paired baseline-vs-updated contrast is

verifier_bootstrap.provenance: results/verifier_bootstrap.json (5 independent draws of the CAEVN training pool; each fold re-decoded and retrained from scratch, evaluated on the paired comparison with the deployed operating point fixed)
